{{Quote|Why do weird things tend to happen when those kids from the Acolyte Program are around?|Anonymous Imperial officer|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''Imperial Sith Acolytes''' were elite [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] deployed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], founded by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].

Imperial Sith Acolytes were trained on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as part of the Acolyte Program and frequently worked alongside the [[Saber Guard]]s. They quickly gained a reputation for their aggressive training techniques, characterized by their resistance against most [[Force power/Legends|force techniques]], as well as their ability to channel the Force for destructive purposes. It is unknown whether they were recruited from Force-sensitive Imperials, or whether they were stable [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Death/Legends|late]] [[Galen Marek]]. It is possible that their number comprised members both Human and clone.

Many Acolytes were deployed to newly subjugated worlds such as [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], others were stationed on Kamino. A few Acolytes participated in the assault on the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the fledgling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], during the [[Assault on Kamino]]. [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], a renegade clone of Marek, killed many of the Sith Acolytes in his quest to find [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] and ultimately [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]].

==History==
The Acolyte program was created shortly after the [[Death/Legends|demise]] of the [[Galen Marek|original Starkiller]]. After Galen Marek's infiltration of the Death Star, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] instigated the program for more protection. The Emperor's apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], used the program as an excuse for the Empire to return to Kamino, and experiment with cloning his apprentice. The Acolytes, wearing red [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|chestplates]] and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] similar to the [[Saber Guard]], received extensive training in the Force from unknown [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] (or possibly Vader himself), in the [[Timira City Cloning Facility]]. The first batch of these warriors were stationed on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] and were assigned to serve under the command of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]].<ref name="TFUII" />

During their training, the Acolytes exhibited a murderously sadistic sense of humor, repeatedly using their Force powers to stage "accidents" around the facility, heedless of the personnel injuries and deaths that they caused. Not over familiar with the Force's applications and ignorant as to the main purpose of the Acolyte program, the hapless facility workers could do nothing but wonder what had caused the "accidents", though the fact that the Acolytes were always around when they occurred did make at least one Imperial suspicious.<ref name="TFUII" />

Despite their training, the Sith Acolytes were ultimately overpowered by [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], a rogue clone of Marek who [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaped]] from Kamino in order to find [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]&mdash;the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] with whom Marek fell in love prior to his death. During his time on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], Starkiller single-handedly annihilated all of the Acolytes that stood in his path. He then [[Rescue of Rahm Kota|rescued]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] from the [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]] [[Tarko-se Arena|arena]].<ref name="TFUII" />

Shortly after the events on Cato Neimoidia, the Acolytes and other Imperial units&mdash;including [[Saber Guard]]s&mdash;boarded the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] during the [[Assault on Kamino|Rebel invasion of Kamino]]. Despite their capture of the hangar, engine room, and various gun emplacements, the boarding parties were systematically wiped out by Starkiller. Many Acolytes also perished in the fighting throughout Timira City while the rest of their Imperial comrades suffered high casualties against Starkiller and the Alliance. Their failure to defend Kamino ultimately resulted in a major victory for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], as well as the capture of Darth Vader.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Powers and abilities==
Imperial Sith Acolytes displayed adequate ability in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. They utilized a set of Force techniques which made them impervious to Force attacks. Acolytes were also able to generate abilities such as [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force push]], [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Repulse|Force repulse]]. However, their sole focus on utilizing Force-based attacks left them extremely vulnerable against individuals trained in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="TFUII" />
